Reuters / CNBC / NBC News / Politico / FT / Al Jazeera / NYT — 23-24 Sep 2026, broke ~23:00 BST Wed 23 Sep
(Search snippet content for FT/NYT — full articles paywalled; each outlet's own reporting language)

HEADLINE: US, China agree to extend trade truce by two months, work on bigger deal, Bessent says

REUTERS (https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-treasurys-bessent-chinas-he-meet-unfinished-business-before-trump-xi-summit-2026-09-23/):
"WASHINGTON, Sept 23 (Reuters) - The United States and China have agreed to extend by two months a trade truce that was due to expire on November 10, allowing more time to work on a potentially bigger trade deal, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday."

POLITICO (https://www.politico.com/news/2026/09/23/u-s-china-trade-truce-extended-two-months-01091121):
"Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Wednesday evening that the U.S. and China have agreed to extend their trade truce, shortly after Chinese leader Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for two days of meetings."
QUOTE (Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary, on Fox News' "Special Report with Bret Baier"):
"That is going to be extended until January 10 to give us more time to see what we can do on the economic front," adding that both countries are still trying to hash out a potentially larger deal.

CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/24/us-china-trade-truce-bessent-trump-xi.html):
"U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Fox News the U.S.-China trade truce would be extended until January 10. The U.S. and China have extended a truce to keep tariffs lower for longer and rare earths flowing... The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10. Ahead of this week's summit, many had expected the truce would be extended by six months or longer."

NBC NEWS (https://www.nbcnews.com/business/economy/us-china-extend-trade-truce-trump-rcna599525):
"The U.S. and China have agreed to extend their trade truce, which was set to expire in November, through Jan. 10."

FT (https://www.ft.com/content/8ff1b8fd-ff58-42a4-8e44-6a31f6db8154) — search snippet, full article paywalled; FT's own reporting language:
"President Xi Jinping and first lady Peng Liyuan landed at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday evening for a high-stakes summit with US President Donald Trump as the US and China agreed to extend their trade war truce until January. Shortly after the Chinese leader landed, US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent told Fox News that the two countries had agreed to extend their one-year trade war truce, which was set to expire on November 10, until January 10."

NYT (https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/23/us/politics/china-trade-truce-tariffs.html) — search snippet, full article paywalled; NYT's own reporting language:
"The Treasury secretary, who is leading talks with China, said the countries had agreed to extend a trade truce until January."

AL JAZEERA (https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/23/trump-meets-chinas-xi-jinping-at-us-airport-on-arrival-for-three-day-trip):
Headline: "Trump welcomes Xi to Washington as US, China agree to extend trade truce"

CONTEXT (Reuters, 24 Sep): the truce paused a trade war that saw mutual tariffs top 100%.
